# Payroll Readiness Checklist

## Critical controls

- database backups enabled
- restore drill completed recently
- export format approved by accounting
- audit logs queryable by date and user

## High priority controls

- boundary tests for overtime windows
- incident severity levels documented
- access review schedule defined

## Medium priority controls

- retention policy reviewed
- privacy assessment refreshed
- ownership assigned for each reliability control

## Recommendation

Do not declare the system payroll-ready unless all critical items pass.
